message:
The users API test now passes. `npm test` reports 1 pass and 0 failures.

The code was writing to a `full_name` column, but migration 001 creates the column as `fullname`. I changed `src/api/users.js` to use `fullname` in both `createUser` and `getUser`.

I left the migrations alone. 001 is already applied in production and the DBA team owns it, so renaming the column there would have caused a mismatch.
